name: A morning walk: park and palace gate
why: A slow morning. Hibiya Park, then Sakuradamon Gate and the open plaza of the Outer Gardens, and back the same way.
steps: Walk to Hibiya Park, about 10 minutes.
The fountain, the pond and the old trees. Take your time.
The samurai-era gate and the moat. From the plaza you can see the palace grounds across the lawn.
The same way, through Hibiya Park. You are back at the hotel by about 8:45.
moves: All on foot and flat. About 4.8 km in total, about 60 minutes of walking plus stops.
good: Time to sit and look, and still back with a margin before 9:00.
mind: Nijubashi bridge is about 10 minutes further on from Sakuradamon. If you feel good, go on and take a taxi back.
